text_en: King Solomon loved many foreign women along with the daughter of Pharaoh: Moabite, Ammonite, Edomite, Sidonian, and Hittite women,
text_cn: 撒罗满除了法郎的公主外，又爱上了许多外国女子：即摩阿布女子，阿孟女子，厄东女子，漆冬女子，赫特女子。

text_en: from the nations concerning which the Lord had said to the Israelites, “You shall not enter into marriage with them, neither shall they with you; for they will surely incline your heart to follow their gods”; Solomon clung to these in love.
text_cn: 关于这些民族，上主曾吩咐以色列子民说：“你们不可到他们中间去，他们也不可到你们中间来，否则他们必会引诱你们的心，倾向他们的神。”但是，撒罗满却恋爱这些女子。

text_en: Among his wives were seven hundred princesses and three hundred concubines; and his wives turned away his heart.
text_cn: 他有七百个各地公主为妻妾，另外还有三百妃子；这些妻妾终于败坏了他的心。

text_en: For when Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not true to the Lord his God, as was the heart of his father David.
text_cn: 当撒罗满年老的时候，这些妻妾迷惑了他的心，勾引他去崇拜别的神；他的心已不像他父亲达味的心，全属于上主他的天主。

text_en: For Solomon followed Astarte the goddess of the Sidonians, and Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
text_cn: 这样，他随从了漆冬人的女神阿巿托勒特，和阿孟人的可憎之物米耳公。

text_en: So Solomon did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , and did not completely follow the Lord , as his father David had done.
text_cn: 撒罗满作了上主眼中视为恶的事，不像他父亲达味那样全心服从上主。

text_en: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Molech the abomination of the Ammonites, on the mountain east of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 那时，撒罗满在耶路撒冷东面的山上，为摩阿布人的可憎之物革摩士，为阿孟子民的可憎之物摩肋客，修筑了丘坛。

text_en: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who offered incense and sacrificed to their gods.
text_cn: 他为所有的外国妻妾，都修筑了丘坛，各给自己的神焚香献祭。

text_en: Then the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned away from the Lord , the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
text_cn: 上主遂向撒罗满发怒，因为他的心偏离了两次显现给他的上主以色列的天主。

text_en: and had commanded him concerning this matter, that he should not follow other gods; but he did not observe what the Lord commanded.
text_cn: 当时，上主对此事曾吩咐过他，不可去随从别的神，但他却没有遵守上主的命令。

text_en: Therefore the Lord said to Solomon, “Since this has been your mind and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes that I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you and give it to your servant.
text_cn: 于是，上主对撒罗满说：“你既然这样行事，不遵守我的盟约，和我吩咐你的诫命，我必要夺去你的王国，赐给你的一个臣仆。

text_en: Yet for the sake of your father David I will not do it in your lifetime; I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
text_cn: 虽然如此，但为了你父亲达味的缘故，在你有生之日，我不作这事；我将要由你儿子手中夺去。

text_en: I will not, however, tear away the entire kingdom; I will give one tribe to your son, for the sake of my servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen. ”
text_cn: 但是仍不完全夺去，为了我仆人达味和我所拣选的耶路撒冷，我仍给你的儿子留下一支派"。

text_en: Then the Lord raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite; he was of the royal house in Edom.
text_cn: 那时，上主兴起一个反抗撒罗满的人，就是厄东王的后裔，厄东人哈达得。

text_en: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the commander of the army went up to bury the dead, he killed every male in Edom
text_cn: 当达味打败厄东后，军长约阿布前去埋葬阵亡的人时，杀死了厄东所有的男子；

text_en: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had eliminated every male in Edom);
text_cn: 约阿布和全以色列在厄东逗留了六个月，直到将厄东所有的男子完全杀掉。

text_en: but Hadad fled to Egypt with some Edomites who were servants of his father. He was a young boy at that time.
text_cn: 哈达得却同他父亲的几个臣仆厄东人逃往埃及，那时哈达得还很年轻。

text_en: They set out from Midian and came to Paran; they took people with them from Paran and came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, assigned him an allowance of food, and gave him land.
text_cn: 他们从米德杨起身，到了帕兰，从帕兰又带了些人来到埃及，投奔埃及王法郎；法郎给了他一座房屋，供给他食用，又给了他一块土地。

text_en: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him his sister-in-law for a wife, the sister of Queen Tahpenes.
text_cn: 哈达得在法郎眼前很是得宠，因此将自己的妻子塔培乃斯王后的妹妹，嫁给他为妻。

text_en: The sister of Tahpenes gave birth by him to his son Genubath, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the children of Pharaoh.
text_cn: 塔培乃斯的妹妹给哈达得生了一个儿子叫革奴巴特。塔培乃斯在法郎宫中抚养他，因此革奴巴特便住在法郎宫中，同法郎的公子们在一起。

text_en: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his ancestors and that Joab the commander of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country. ”
text_cn: 哈达得在埃及听说达味已与他的列祖同眠，军长约阿布也已去世，便对法郎说：“请让我走，回到我故乡去！”

text_en: But Pharaoh said to him, “What do you lack with me that you now seek to go to your own country? ” And he said, “No, do let me go. ”
text_cn: 法郎对他说：“你在我这里缺少什么，竟想回到你的故乡去？”他回答说：“什么也不缺，只求你让我回去！”

text_en: God raised up another adversary against Solomon, Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, King Hadadezer of Zobah.
text_cn: 天主又兴起一个反抗撒罗满的人，就是厄肋雅达的儿子勒宗。他由自己的主人祚巴王哈达德则尔前出走。

text_en: He gathered followers around him and became leader of a marauding band, after the slaughter by David; they went to Damascus, settled there, and made him king in Damascus.
text_cn: 在达味击杀阿兰人时，聚集了一些人，作了土匪头目，去了大马士革，盘踞在那里，做了大马士革王。

text_en: He was an adversary of Israel all the days of Solomon, making trouble as Hadad did; he despised Israel and reigned over Aram.
text_cn: 撒罗满有生之日，勒宗始终与以色列为敌。。 哈达得就回国了。哈达得的危害，即在于他作了厄东的君王，不断骚扰以色列。

text_en: Jeroboam son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, rebelled against the king.
text_cn: 厄弗辣大地责勒达人，乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕，──他的母亲名叫责鲁阿，是个寡妇──原是撒罗满的臣仆，他也起来反抗君王。

text_en: The following was the reason he rebelled against the king. Solomon built the Millo, and closed up the gap in the wall of the city of his father David.
text_cn: 他反抗君王的原委是这样：当时撒罗满正在建筑米罗，修葺(qì)他父亲达味城的裂口；

text_en: The man Jeroboam was very able, and when Solomon saw that the young man was industrious he gave him charge over all the forced labor of the house of Joseph.
text_cn: 雅洛贝罕这个人原很有才能，撒罗满见这少年人很能做事，便派他监督若瑟族的一切劳役。

text_en: About that time, when Jeroboam was leaving Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the road. Ahijah had clothed himself with a new garment. The two of them were alone in the open country
text_cn: 有一次，雅洛贝罕走出耶路撒冷，史罗的先知阿希雅在路上遇见了他；先知身上穿着一件新外衣，在田间只有他们二人。

text_en: when Ahijah laid hold of the new garment he was wearing and tore it into twelve pieces.
text_cn: 阿希雅便拿起他所穿的新外衣，撕成了十二块，

text_en: He then said to Jeroboam: Take for yourself ten pieces; for thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, “See, I am about to tear the kingdom from the hand of Solomon, and will give you ten tribes.
text_cn: 然后对雅洛贝罕说：“你拿十块，因为上主以色列的天主这样说：看，我必将撒罗满手中的王国撕裂，将十个支派交给你。

text_en: One tribe will remain his, for the sake of my servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city that I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel.
text_cn: 为了我仆人达味，和我从以色列支派中选的耶路撒冷城的缘故，仍给他留下一支派，

text_en: This is because he has forsaken me, worshiped Astarte the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the Ammonites, and has not walked in my ways, doing what is right in my sight and keeping my statutes and my ordinances, as his father David did.
text_cn: 因为他背弃了我，崇拜了漆冬人的女神阿市托勒特、摩阿布人的神革摩士和阿孟人的神米耳公。他没有像他父亲达味那样履行我的道路，行我视为正义的事，恪守我的律例和诫命。

text_en: Nevertheless I will not take the whole kingdom away from him but will make him ruler all the days of his life, for the sake of my servant David whom I chose and who did keep my commandments and my statutes;
text_cn: 但我不愿从他手中夺去整个王国，我要使他有生之日作首领，是为了我所选的仆人达味的缘故，因为他遵守了我的诫命和律例。

text_en: but I will take the kingdom away from his son and give it to you—that is, the ten tribes.
text_cn: 我却要从他儿子的手中夺回王国，给你十个支派，

text_en: Yet to his son I will give one tribe, so that my servant David may always have a lamp before me in Jerusalem, the city where I have chosen to put my name.
text_cn: 只留下一个支派给他的儿子，使我的仆人达味，在我所拣选立我名的耶路撒冷城中，在我面前常有一盏明灯。

text_en: I will take you, and you shall reign over all that your soul desires; you shall be king over Israel.
text_cn: 我选取你，使你随意统治一切，作以色列的君王。

text_en: If you will listen to all that I command you, walk in my ways, and do what is right in my sight by keeping my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, I will be with you, and will build you an enduring house, as I built for David, and I will give Israel to you.
text_cn: 如果你听从我吩咐你的一切，履行我的道路，行我视为正义的事，恪守我的律例和诫命，如同我的仆人达味一样，我必与你同在，为你建立一巩固的家室，像我为达味所建立的一样。我将以色列交给你，

text_en: For this reason I will punish the descendants of David, but not forever. ”
text_cn: 藉以贬抑达味的后裔，但不致于久远。”

text_en: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam; but Jeroboam promptly fled to Egypt, to King Shishak of Egypt, and remained in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
text_cn: 因此，撒罗满想杀害雅洛贝罕，雅洛贝罕遂起身逃往埃及，投奔埃及王史沙克；他住在埃及，直到撒罗满逝世。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, all that he did as well as his wisdom, are they not written in the Book of the Acts of Solomon?
text_cn: 撒罗满其余的事迹，他的一切作为和智慧，都记载在《撒罗满实录》上。

text_en: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
text_cn: 撒罗满在耶路撒冷作王，统治全以色列，凡四十年。

text_en: Solomon slept with his ancestors and was buried in the city of his father David; and his son Rehoboam succeeded him.
text_cn: 撒罗满与他的列祖同眠，葬在他父亲达味城内；他的儿子勒哈贝罕继位为王。
